section: 9. Historical Failure and Abandoned Research Investigation
required_behavior: Treat historical failures as valuable engineering evidence. Investigate: - Closed and unmerged pull requests. - Rejected patches. - Reverted commits. - Abandoned architecture proposals. - Experimental drivers. - Incomplete subsystems. - Failed releases. - Historical regressions. - Previously unsuccessful compatibility approaches. - Unresolved developer disagreements. - Long-standing bug reports. - Abandoned ReactOS-derived operating systems. - Failed Windows compatibility projects. For every significant historical attempt, establish: - What was attempted. - Why it was attempted. - What evidence demonstrated failure or success. - Whether rejection was technical, architectural, legal, procedural or resource-related. - Which dependencies were missing. - Whether conditions have subsequently changed. - Whether the approach remains relevant. - Whether a different solution is preferable.
